WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.*,
    CASE WHEN e.user_id IS NOT NULL AND e.user_id <> '' THEN e.user_id ELSE COALESCE(i.person_id, e.person_id) END AS pid
  FROM events e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT distinct_id, MIN(person_id) AS person_id
    FROM identities
    WHERE project = 'demo'
    GROUP BY distinct_id
  ) i ON i.distinct_id = e.distinct_id
  WHERE e.project = 'demo'
    AND e.ts_ms >= 1793269640137
    AND e.ts_ms < 1793874440137
    AND e.event IN ('$pageview', 'signup_completed', 'subscription_started')
),
firsts AS (SELECT distinct_id, MIN(ts_ms) AS t FROM ev WHERE event = '$pageview' GROUP BY distinct_id),
touch AS (
  SELECT ev.distinct_id, MIN(COALESCE(NULLIF(ev.referrer_host, ''), 'Direct / None')) AS val
  FROM ev JOIN firsts ON firsts.distinct_id = ev.distinct_id AND ev.ts_ms = firsts.t AND ev.event = '$pageview'
  GROUP BY ev.distinct_id
),
visits AS (SELECT distinct_id, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions, COUNT(*) AS views FROM ev WHERE event = '$pageview' GROUP BY distinct_id),
conv AS (SELECT DISTINCT distinct_id FROM ev WHERE event IN ('signup_completed', 'subscription_started'))
SELECT touch.val AS val, COUNT(*) AS visitors, SUM(visits.sessions) AS sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN conv.distinct_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS converted,
  SUM(CASE WHEN visits.views = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bounced
FROM touch
JOIN visits ON visits.distinct_id = touch.distinct_id
LEFT JOIN conv ON conv.distinct_id = touch.distinct_id
GROUP BY touch.val ORDER BY visitors DESC LIMIT 25
summary: Top referrers by visitors: Direct / None 376 (10.9% converted), google.com 174 (16.7% converted), news.ycombinator.com 54 (13.0% converted), reddit.com 51 (9.8% converted), t.co 42 (11.9% converted).
